mentions.name: AnyWager
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that scans the pages you read and highlights text that maps to a Kalshi prediction market; hovering the highlight shows a tooltip for placing money on the market directly from the page. Intended for betting on sports while doomscrolling Twitter or passively gambling on geopolitical events while reading the news.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a chrome extension that scans everything you read and highlights text if it maps to a market on kalshi. On hover, a tooltip pops up allowing you to drop money on it.
